column1: # The licence texts a program linking @kama/rmlui carries, after friendly-fire-department's licenses/manifest.tsv.
#   key       an identifier for a consumer's own manifest or credits check
#   legs      which builds CONTAIN the component: `native` (every desktop build that links this package). There is no
#             web row: @kama/rmlui is not in a wasm build (the web leg of @kama/ui is the browser's DOM).
#   licence   the SPDX-ish id, short enough for a credits screen
#   text      path to the full text, relative to this package's root — COMMITTED, never fetched at packaging time
#   screen    the name a credits screen shows
# ⚠️ RmlUi VENDORS TWO CONTAINER LIBRARIES AND `RmlUi-MIT.txt` DOES NOT COVER THEM. friendly-fire-department's FR-28
# found 472 robin_hood + itlib symbols in a shipped binary against a notice that named neither. Their text is RmlUi's
# Include/RmlUi/Core/Containers/LICENSE.txt, a separate row because they are separate copyright holders.
# ⚠️ FreeType is dual FTL / GPLv2; this package ELECTS the FTL. The FTL asks for a credit line in the documentation
# (README.md, "What a program that ships this must carry"). Its built-in copy of zlib's inflate asks nothing of a binary.
# tools/fetch-rmlui.sh and tools/fetch-freetype.sh compare each text with the pinned tree and warn on a difference.
